rules.rule_text:
title: Local Groups Discovery Attempt - Linux
id: 676381a6-15ca-4d73-a9c8-6a22e970b90d
status: test
description: 'Detects attempts to enumerate local groups and group membership via
  common Linux utilities and sensitive file access.

  Adversaries may read files such as /etc/group and /etc/gshadow, or use tools like
  getent and groups to identify

  group memberships and privilege assignments on a compromised system.

  '
references:
- https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team/blob/f339e7da7d05f6057fdfcdd3742bfcf365fee2a9/atomics/T1069.001/T1069.001.md
- https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/getent.1.html
author: "\xD6mer G\xFCnal, Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community"
date: 2020-10-11
modified: 2026-11-03
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1069.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_groups:
    Image|endswith: /groups
  selection_read_utilities:
    Image|endswith:
    - /cat
    - /ed
    - /emacs
    - /head
    - /less
    - /makemap
    - /more
    - /nano
    - /sqlite3
    - /tail
    - /vi
    - /vim
    CommandLine|contains:
    - group
    - gshadow
  selection_getent:
    Image|endswith: /getent
    CommandLine|contains:
    - ' group'
    - ' gshadow'
  selection_ypcat:
    Image|endswith: /ypcat
    CommandLine|contains: group
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administration activities
level: low
